name: Bloomhaven

stars.name: Bloomhaven
stars.notes: Bright yellow-white star with slightly higher UV output than Sol, driving accelerated photosynthetic evolution on its habitable worlds

planets.name: Glassroot
planets.notes: Greenhouse-effect world with a thick silicate haze atmosphere. Surface temperatures exceed 700K, but unusual crystalline growths dot its plains.

planets.name: Floravast
planets.notes: Hyper-fertile garden world where indigenous plant life grows at extraordinary rates due to the star's enhanced UV output. Continent-spanning flower blooms shift the planet's visible color seasonally. Population 3.9 billion.

planets.name: Coraldeep
planets.notes: Deep ocean world with bioluminescent reef systems extending to abyssal depths. Population 1.1 billion in submersible cities and surface platforms.

planets.name: Dryreach
planets.notes: Arid world with seasonal dust storms. Hardy extremophilic lichen covers polar regions, representing the system's simplest biosphere.

planets.name: Bloomhaven Major
planets.notes: Vivid green-gold banded giant. Its extensive moon system includes two with subsurface oceans and one with a thin breathable atmosphere.

planets.name: Hazerim
planets.notes: Methane ice world with a hazy orange atmosphere. Atmospheric mining operations extract rare noble gases.

planets.name: Lastlight
planets.notes: Distant ice body at the system's edge. An automated telescope array monitors deep space from its surface.

anomalies.name: The Bloom Pulse
anomalies.notes: Every 7.3 standard years, all plant life on Floravast enters a synchronized super-bloom lasting approximately 40 days. The event is visible from orbit as the planet shifts from green to vivid polychromatic hues. No satisfactory explanation for the synchronization has been found.

asteroid_belts.name: The Petal Scatter
asteroid_belts.notes: Contains carbonaceous asteroids rich in organic precursor molecules. Some fragments show signs of biological contamination from Floravast ejecta.

stations.name: Bloomhaven Grand Exchange
stations.notes: Major trade station specializing in botanical exports—seeds, pharmaceuticals, exotic timbers, and genetic samples from Floravast's hyper-productive biosphere.

stations.name: Abyssal Platform
stations.notes: Deep-sea research coordination center. Manages submersible expeditions studying Coraldeep's bioluminescent reef ecology.

stations.name: Hazerim Extraction Hub
stations.notes: Atmospheric mining platform harvesting xenon and krypton from Hazerim's dense methane atmosphere.

faction_control.notes: Unique governance structure where political authority is vested in a network of botanical guilds. Economic power derives from control of Floravast's genetic resources.

history: First cataloged in 2251, the system's unusually productive biosphere attracted immediate interest from agricultural corporations and xenobotanists alike.

The Horticultural Syndicate emerged organically from the botanical guilds that managed early colonization, formalizing into a governing body in 2278 after disputes over genetic resource rights required centralized arbitration.
The first observed Bloom Pulse in 2284 transformed scientific understanding of Floravast's ecology, revealing a planetary-scale coordination mechanism that remains unexplained decades later.
description: Bloomhaven's star burns bright and slightly blue-shifted, bathing its worlds in enhanced ultraviolet light that has driven plant evolution into overdrive. Floravast is the result—a world where vegetation grows with almost aggressive vitality, where forests can reclaim cleared ground in months and flower blooms paint entire continents in shifting color. The planet's botanical productivity exceeds any known world by an order of magnitude, producing biomass at rates that challenge ecological models. Coraldeep offers a submarine counterpart, its bioluminescent reefs extending from surface to abyss in structures so vast they register on gravitational surveys.

The Horticultural Syndicate governs Bloomhaven with the careful attention of master gardeners tending a prize collection. Floravast's genetic resources are the system's greatest asset—pharmaceutical compounds, crop strains engineered from indigenous templates, and exotic timbers command premium prices across known space. The Syndicate licenses access ruthlessly, ensuring that no single corporation can monopolize the biological wealth flowing through the Grand Exchange. Coraldeep's submersible cities operate under similar principles, with marine harvest quotas enforced by the Syndicate's conservation fleet.

The Bloom Pulse is Bloomhaven's great enigma. Every 7.3 years, without any identified trigger, every photosynthetic organism on Floravast enters simultaneous super-bloom. The planet transforms—green gives way to riots of color as billions of species flower in unison, releasing clouds of pollen and spores that turn the atmosphere hazy gold. No chemical signal, no seismic event, no stellar fluctuation has been correlated with the Pulse. Some xenobotanists theorize a planet-wide root network, a fungal internet connecting all plant life. Others suggest something stranger: that Floravast's biosphere functions as a single superorganism, and the Bloom Pulse is its heartbeat.
